tierList.title: Character strength ranking
tierList.hint: Each Pokémon on three pure dice built for them, scored by alternating their {n} best moves
tierList.assumptions: Every Pokémon is assumed to throw three pure dice of whichever type its own moves ask for most. Weakness and the opposing Pokémon are left out. Tap a row to see the moves behind the figure.
tierList.countIndirect: Count worth that is not damage (reduction, denial)
tierList.hintPerTurn: The game split into HP bands, each scored by alternating the {n} best moves castable there, weighted by how much of a game is spent in it
tierList.premiseNote: Conditional moves: a condition you can set up yourself is priced with the turn it costs to set up, and a condition nobody elects is weighted by how often it holds. Those frequencies come from the card pool — 25% of turns below 40 HP, 50% below 80, and a 16% chance the dice failed last turn.
tierList.disclaimer: These figures are a guide only — a real match is a good deal more complicated.
tierList.rotationNote: A move cannot be cast twice running — last turn’s move is locked out — so this is the average of the best two alternating rather than the single best repeated. Three slots covers the opponent locking one of them out.
